what_i_see: Faint, clumpy, elongated low-surface-brightness feature at centre, between a red edge-on galaxy ~4" E and a brighter compact galaxy ~3" W, aligned with both.
most_likely: A faint background galaxy projected between neighbours, or tidal debris in an interacting pair.
decisive_test: Redshifts of the three components: matching values would make it tidal debris; otherwise a chance alignment.
catalogue_notes: No SIMBAD at centre; nearest NED WISEA J045305.41-483440.8 ~16". Gaia G=20.7 at 24" only. No DR8 photo-z rows even within 60" (coverage gap). No match in Jacobs+2019, Huang+2020/2021 (cone 10"; Rojas+2022 query unvalidated).
